arguments.arg0:
"Adds position offset to the AvatarLOD debug Label.\n" +
             "Works when AvatarLODManager::displayLODLabels is enabled."
"Keyboard Debug controls only work inside Unity Editor."
"Enable performance optimization for avatar that runs static animation, or avatar that can potentially be paused and frozen"

"When enabled, this allows locomotion animations to play on the local avatar. By default the locomotion animations only play on " +
            "the remote manifestations of the avatar, as having them play on the local, first-person avatar can make things feel incorrect. " +
            "In most cases, this should not be enabled, but there are situations in which this option can be useful."

"This option enables an offset that is applied to the avatar's position depending on the orientation of the headset. This " +
            "has the effect of moving the avatar's center of mass forward or backward as they look up and down. This can help mitigate clipping " +
            "issues between the arms and torso when looking straight down and interacting with things very close to the avatar, but it can also " +
            "lead to foot sliding, so its best used conditionally. Only works when AnchoringState is set to AnchorToFloor."
"Controller input blend factor for left arm"
"Controller input blend factor for the right arm"

"By Default, only the left and right arms are input blended. If this is enabled, also blends the entire " +
                 "upper body tracking input into the animation pose, everything above the waist (head, hands, torso, etc.)." +
                 "In most cases, this should not be enabled, but there are situations in which this option can be useful." +
                 "Only works when Anchoring State is Anchor to Floor."
"Blend factor for the upper body. 1 is full tracking input, 0 is full animation"
"Blend factor between default and custom animation. 0 is full default animation and 1 is full custom animation"

"When true, the animation controller will observe the vertical position of the tracking data to determine " +
            "if the avatar should enter a crouching state. When false, the avatar will never enter the crouching state."

"When enabled, this allows the upper body of an avatar to rotate independently of the lower body. When the difference " +
            "in angle between the upper body and lower body grows larger than the max upper body angle deviation, the lower body will " +
            "automatically rotate to face the same direction as the upper body. When disabled, the lower body of the avatar will always " +
            "remain in sync with the upper body."

"When independent upper body horizontal rotation is enabled, this value determines the angle threshold between the upper " +
            "and lower body, past which the lower body will automatically rotate to align with the upper body."

"When independent upper body horizontal rotation is enabled, this value determines how many degrees per second the lower " +
            "body can rotate in order to align with the upper body."

"Enabling this allows the scale of the corresponding remote avatar to be adjusted using the RemoteScaleFactor property. " +
            "This lets you adjust the height of the avatar on remote devices to better match the actual height of the user. Please note that " +
            "the RemoteScaleFactor must be manually synced accross the network and applied to the Transform of remote avatars."

"When EnableRemoteScaling is enabled, this property allows you to control the scale of the remote avatar. This can be " +
            "helpful for adjusting the size of the avatar to better match the height of the user. Please note that this value must be manually " +
            "synced across the network and applied to the Transform of remote avatars."

"Scalar applied to the maximum arm length, which is used to mitigate avatar arm stretching. Increase this value to " +
            "allow the avatar's arms to stretch further, or decrease it to keep the hands closer to the avatar. Defaults to 1."
"This property contains options meant for use only with mixed reality applications."
"Contains options for overriding the transforms of specific joints."
"When enabled, the joint will be locked to the transform set on the overrideTransform property below."
"When the override is enabled, the joint will be locked to the position and orientation defined by this transform."

"This property controls how long (in seconds) it takes for the joint to transition into and out of the overridden postion " +
                "and orientation when the override is toggled. This prevents the avatar from popping when enabling or disabling the override. " +
                "If you want an instantaneous transition, set this to 0."
"The color to render the skeleton in"
"The main behavior to use inside the behavior.zip file"
"Behavior zip file path inside the streaming asset folder"
"The default (non-custom)/custom state transition parameter id as defined in the custom animation graph"
"This value controls how many units the avatar must move before the linear motion animations will start to play. This allows the avatar to shift in place without lifting their feet."
"When true, the avatar will be able to enter the crouching state when the tracked headset position goes below the required height threshold. When false, crouching is disabled."
"This value controls how far below the initial headset position the tracked pose must go before the avatar enters the crouching state. This assumes that the user starts in the standing position."
"This value controls how far the tracked pose must move vertically for the avatar to go from fully upright at the crouch start threshold to being fully crouched."
"Enable this have the avatar start sitting in their current position."
"Enable this to be able to override the animation controller parameters using the properties below."

"Enable this to have the avatar automatically return to a standing position if " +
            "there is no motion after the Crouch Timeout Duration expires."

"When the Crouch Timeout is enabled, this value determines how long the avatar will remain in " +
            "the crouching position before automatically returning to the standing position when not moving."
"The avatar entity in which we want to change preset on"
"The preset value we want to change to"
"Enable overriding Avatar LOD levels using controller/keyboard input."

"Enable using keyboard buttons for increasing/decreasing LOD levels. " +
             "Default buttons:\nG to increase LOD levels\nF to decrease LOD levels."
"Display LOD Levels next to each Avatar (see AvatarLODManager::displayLODLabels)."
"Manual specification of Audio Source. Default will use any attached to the same object."
"Button name used to drive HoldToSpeak and PushToSpeak methods of control."
"The max amount of time to wait for mic recording to start."
"LOD level to capture avatar data with"

"Toggle this on to enable simulated network latency to see how network conditions " +

        "resulting in immediate playback on the remote Avatar. If you don't want to use " +

"Attempt to load the Avatar model file from the Content Delivery Network (CDN) based on a userID, as opposed to loading from disk."
